doc_kind: medical coverage guideline (payer-written policy, evidence summary + position statement)
lines_of_business: All lines of business unless noted in Program Exceptions
Medicare Advantage: NCD 150.10 Lumbar Artificial Disc Replacement reviewed
sections_in_order: Position Statement (Surgery for Spinal Deformity; Lumbar Discectomy/Microdiscectomy; Lumbar Laminectomy; Lumbar Spinal Fusion; Lumbar Total Disc Arthroplasty)
criteria_location: Position Statement, pp.3-8 of 16: five stacked procedure blocks (deformity fusion, discectomy, laminectomy, lumbar fusion by diagnosis, total disc arthroplasty). The shared conservative-therapy definition is repeated inline in each block; deformity has its own '*Non-operative care' footnote and fusion has a '++' footnote. Evidence summary (pp.1-3) and 65 references are not criteria.
procedures_covered: Lumbar spinal fusion (single or multi-level) for 10 diagnosis pathways
Codes also list removal/revision of artificial disc (0164T, 0165T) with no criteria

logic.top_level: pathways (separate criteria per procedure, and inside fusion one OR-list of ten diagnosis pathways, each with its own ALL/ANY)

k_of_n.quote: Signs and symptoms of radiculopathy on history and physical exam, including at least 2 of the following
Documented failure of at least twelve (12) consecutive weeks in the past year of any 2 of the following physician-directed conservative treatments

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Fusion: closing list 'considered experimental or investigational if the sole indication for fusion is any one of the following' (disc herniation, chronic nonspecific LBP, DDD, initial discectomy/laminectomy, facet syndrome). Disc arthroplasty: inline 'no contraindications ... including but not limited to' list of 9 items (open-ended).
logic.initial_vs_repeat: No general repeat rule. Repeat situations are separate fusion pathways: 'Recurrent, same-level disc herniation, at least 3 months after previous disc surgery'; 'Pseudarthrosis ... No less than 6 months after initial fusion'; 'Adjacent-level disease ... previous fusion resulted in significant relief for at least 6 months'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Spinal stenosis with one of the following: Associated spondylolisthesis ..., OR Spinal instability ..., OR Spinal instability is anticipated ..., AND Either of the following, a or b
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: The AND after the third OR bullet is at the same indent as the three OR bullets; scope of AND (all of the first block AND (a or b)) is only inferable.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Severe, progressive idiopathic scoliosis with either of the following: Cobb angle greater than 40; Spinal cord compression with neurogenic claudication or radicular pain ... who has failed at least 3 months
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Second bullet looks like it should be a different severity of the same condition, but 'severe, progressive' is not defined and the first bullet has no function or conservative-care condition.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Congenital (Wiltse type I) or acquired pars defect (Wiltse type II), documented on x-ray, and, AND
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Typographical doubled conjunction; also third bullet mixes 'Unresponsive to at least 3 months ... OR with severe or rapidly progressive symptoms' inside an ALL list.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Persistent debilitating back or leg pain (defined as daily pain with a visual analog scale score of 4 or greater and affects ADLs), that is refractory to at least 6 weeks of conservative nonsurgical therapy that included the following
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: OR between 'Rapidly progressing neurologic deficits' and the pain branch; the three inner ANDs apply only to the pain branch.

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: defined as daily pain with a visual analog scale score of 4 or greater and affects ADLs

vague_terms.problem: Undefined except by the footnote list; 'physician-directed' and 'structured' not defined.
No ADL count or instrument (contrast Carelon: at least 2 ADLs/IADLs, pain >=3/10).
No measure; appears in nearly every fusion pathway.

vague_terms.quote: a dose sufficient to induce a therapeutic response
vague_terms.problem: Needs clinician judgment; chart rarely states response.

vague_terms.quote: Evaluation and appropriate management of associated cognitive, behavioral, or addiction issues, if any
vague_terms.problem: 'if any' makes it vacuous when nothing is charted; absence of a note cannot distinguish 'none' from 'not evaluated'.

extraction_hazards: Bullet glyphs and nested o / squares flatten in pdftotext; nesting must be inferred from indentation
The conservative-therapy block is pasted verbatim 5 times (discectomy, laminectomy, fusion '++', TDA, deformity '*') so a parser creates duplicate leaves
'*' and '++' footnote markers are separated from the place they apply; '++' definition is never cited by a marker in the criteria body
Section nav bar (Position Statement, Billing/Coding, ...) appears as text at top of pages 1 and 10
Evidence summary contains numbers (Cobb 30, 70-75 degrees, 50% facet) that look like thresholds but are not criteria
Code table descriptions wrap across lines and drop their code numbers in text extraction
interesting_structures: Fusion is a list of ten diagnosis pathways joined by trailing OR, each with its own timing and conservative-care length
Per-level rule: 'criteria must be met for each level intended for fusion' turns one request into N evaluations
'Experimental or investigational if the SOLE indication is ...' is a negative rule that depends on whether another indication exists
Immediate-evaluation red-flag pathway (neuro deficit) bypasses conservative care entirely

fit_to_tree.why: Mostly all/any with numeric leaves, but the stenosis-fusion AND/OR scope, per-level repetition, 'sole indication' negation and open-ended contraindications need extra structure or judgment.
